note: Manual API mapping ledger for Wave C. The machine-generated source candidate file remains unchanged and not_reviewed; Supported means source/API mapping only, not visual, runtime, accessibility or parity acceptance.

parameters.name: Culture
parameters.mapping: Culture-aware date parse/format and calendar configuration
parameters.rationale: The pinned family counterpart is fluent-text-input, not a date-picker tag. Culture is passed to date formatting, parsing and the embedded picker; this is composite Bluent behavior.

parameters.name: Mode
parameters.mapping: Day/Month/Year calendar mode
parameters.rationale: No dedicated date-picker tag exists in the pinned WC crosswalk. Source also exposes a YearSelect inconsistency: formatting uses yyyy/MM while the mask accepts four digits only.
parameters.followUp: Align YearSelect display format, parser and mask; add one regression per CalendarMode before #438 acceptance.

parameters.name: DateClass
parameters.mapping: Declared per-date CSS callback is not forwarded to DateFieldPicker
parameters.rationale: The current DateField source declares DateClass but never reads or passes it to the embedded picker; the public parameter has no effect.
parameters.followUp: Wire the callback into the picker or explicitly deprecate it through #438 after design/API review.

parameters.name: Max
parameters.mapping: DateFieldPicker upper date boundary
parameters.rationale: Max is passed to the embedded calendar picker, but TryParseValueFromString only parses the typed text and does not enforce the boundary. The pinned text-input CEM has no date-picker contract.
parameters.followUp: Test typed values beyond Max and ensure picker and manual-entry paths share the intended range validation.

parameters.name: Min
parameters.mapping: DateFieldPicker lower date boundary
parameters.rationale: Min is passed to the embedded calendar picker, but TryParseValueFromString only parses the typed text and does not enforce the boundary. The pinned text-input CEM has no date-picker contract.
parameters.followUp: Test typed values below Min and ensure picker and manual-entry paths share the intended range validation.

parameters.name: DisplayCalendar
parameters.mapping: Optional embedded calendar picker button
parameters.rationale: This controls whether DateField renders its calendar picker addon; there is no dedicated date-picker counterpart in the pinned WC catalog.

parameters.name: ParsingErrorMessage
parameters.mapping: Blazor InputBase date parsing validation
parameters.rationale: Custom parsing copy is part of Blazor form validation and has no matching property on the related fluent-text-input tag.

parameters.name: StartAddon
parameters.mapping: fluent-text-input start slot
parameters.rationale: DateField, TimeField and MaskedField forward this fragment to MaskedField, which renders a leading addon region; OtpField does not render this inherited property and overrides it below.

parameters.name: EndAddon
parameters.mapping: fluent-text-input end slot
parameters.rationale: DateField, TimeField and MaskedField forward this fragment to MaskedField, which renders a trailing addon region; OtpField does not render this inherited property and overrides it below.

parameters.name: Size
parameters.mapping: fluent-text-input control-size
parameters.rationale: DateField, TimeField and MaskedField forward FieldSize to MaskedField, which adds the corresponding size class; OtpField does not apply a size class and overrides it below.

parameters.name: BindValueEvent
parameters.mapping: Inherited BindValueEvent is not forwarded to the nested MaskedField
parameters.rationale: DateField binds CurrentValueAsString to a MaskedField component but does not pass its own BindValueEvent; the parent parameter has no effect on the visible input event.
parameters.followUp: Either forward the setting or explicitly remove/deprecate the inherited contract through #438 after API review.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.mapping: Caller class forwarded to the rendered control wrapper
parameters.rationale: DateField, TimeField and MaskedField forward Class to the MaskedField wrapper. OtpField applies Class to its inner OTP group rather than the outer root and overrides it below.

parameters.name: Seconds

parameters.name: Culture
parameters.mapping: Culture-aware time parsing
parameters.rationale: Culture is passed to BindConverter parsing, but TimeOnly/DateTime formatting calls ToString without the Culture argument, so display formatting follows current culture rather than the supplied Culture.
parameters.followUp: Use the supplied Culture consistently for formatting and parsing; test two cultures with different time conventions through #439.

parameters.name: Mask
parameters.mapping: Bluent regex mask lexer and literal insertion
parameters.rationale: A regex-driven partial-input mask has no one-to-one fluent-text-input property. Actual Chrome and Edge typed-input evidence reproduced a literal-prefix corruption: entering 09123456789 yields 0991-234-5678 for the configured 09xx-xxx-xxxx mask.
parameters.followUp: See FLUENT-PARITY-TYPED-FIELDS-BROWSER-AUDIT.md and BLUENT-TYPED-FIELDS-CHROME/EDGE.json. Fix GetLiteralAt/AppendLiterals indexing and add typed-entry, paste, backspace and leading-literal regression tests through #440.

parameters.name: AsciiDigits
parameters.mapping: Normalize accepted digits to ASCII
parameters.rationale: Digit normalization is a Bluent-specific input transformation and has no matching upstream text-input attribute.
parameters.followUp: Define and test precedence when AsciiDigits and ArabicToPersianConversion are both enabled.

parameters.name: ArabicToPersianConversion
parameters.mapping: Convert Arabic digits to Persian digits
parameters.rationale: Culture-specific digit conversion is a Bluent input transformation; when both conversion flags are enabled, source applies ASCII conversion first and Persian conversion second, so the final output is Persian digits.
parameters.followUp: Define mutual exclusion or explicit precedence and add combined-flag tests.

parameters.name: Length
parameters.mapping: Number of one-character OTP cells
parameters.rationale: The control is a multi-cell interaction with one hidden bound value; it is not equivalent to one fluent-text-input field.
parameters.followUp: Test zero/negative, one, long and dynamically changed lengths, including focus and form serialization.

parameters.name: Password
parameters.mapping: Switch OTP cells between text and password input types
parameters.rationale: Per-cell password masking is a composite OTP behavior, not a property of a single upstream text input.
parameters.followUp: Verify native screen-reader announcements and password-mode behavior with real assistive technology.

parameters.name: AutoSubmit
parameters.mapping: OTP interop submits the enclosing form after all cells are filled
parameters.rationale: The interop reads data-otp-auto-submit and calls requestSubmit/submit when the full value is present and an enclosing form exists; this is Bluent form orchestration, not a Fluent input attribute.
parameters.followUp: Add a real form fixture to verify submit count, validation handling and the no-form path in Chrome and Edge.

parameters.name: BindValueEvent
parameters.mapping: OTP interop dispatches the configured DOM event to the hidden bound input
parameters.rationale: The JS interop reads data-otp-blazor-event and dispatches the selected event after updating the hidden input; this is Blazor-specific glue rather than an upstream custom-element attribute.
parameters.followUp: Verify input/change event variants against actual Blazor binding and EditContext validation.

parameters.followUp: Confirm the intended class target in the approved design and add a DOM contract test.

outOfBandPublicApi.name: InputBase<TValue> binding/validation surface
outOfBandPublicApi.scope: External Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components.Forms.InputBase<TValue>; not counted among the 40 locally declared/inherited parameter occurrences
outOfBandPublicApi.mapping: Value, ValueChanged, ValueExpression and EditContext/validation integration are framework-owned binding contracts
